_note: SAMPLE DATA: Pre-event checklist template for public festivals, charity galas, and community cultural events with volunteer and permit milestones.
name: Community Cultural Festival & Gala Checklist

items.title: Grounds Allotment & Civic Permissions
items.description: Submit application to municipal corporation (Nagar Nigam) for grounds lease, public park usage, and fire safety inspection.

items.title: Police Clearance & Traffic Management Plan
items.description: Meet with local traffic division to map vehicle diversion, parking ground signage, and emergency ambulance access lanes.

items.title: Volunteer Recruitment & Committee Lead Assignment
items.description: Onboard 40+ volunteers across registration, food distribution, crowd flow, stage hospitality, and clean-up squad.

items.title: Cultural Troupe Booking & Sound License (IPRS / PPL)
items.description: Confirm artists, folk dancers, school choir participation, and obtain required public music performance licenses.

items.title: Welcome Arch, Stage Truss & Shamiyana Setup
items.description: Review vendor site inspection for waterproof German hangar tents, green rooms, and drinking water water-cooler kiosks.

items.title: Langar / Food Stall Vendor Health Certificates
items.description: Inspect food preparation hygiene protocols, raw ingredient sourcing, and waste management trash bins.

items.title: Volunteer Briefing & Walkthrough Rehearsal
items.description: Distribute volunteer ID badges, high-visibility jackets, walkie-talkies, and execute crowd evacuation drill.

items.title: First Aid Post & Drinking Water Tanker Dispatch
items.description: Confirm on-site paramedic team, doctor desk, and 4 freshwater tankers with municipal supply.

items.title: Stage Sound Check & Dignitary Protocol Rehearsal
items.description: Test stage monitors, podium microphone, VIP seating arrangement, and award plaques.

items.title: Live Festival Gates Open & Crowd Marshalling
items.description: Station volunteers at entry bag-check gates, manage live announcer broadcasts, and maintain trash clearings.
